tokens.name: surface-app
tokens.usage: App and dashboard background behind every screen. Navy text reads at 13:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets, modals and input fields — anything that sits above surface-app.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deep Navy, the brand core (70-80% of what a person sees). Primary text and icons on surface-app and surface-card (14:1 and 13:1), and the fill for headers, navigation, primary buttons and the logo.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary navy: secondary buttons, the active tab or nav item, links, a chart's second series. Carries on-fill text at 12:1.

tokens.name: navy-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet navy wash behind a selected list row, an information panel or a grouped section header. The only tinted background allowed on a routine screen; navy text reads at 12:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text only: dispense dates, source-clinic captions, helper text, input placeholders. 6:1 on surface-card, 5.7:1 on surface-app. Never for a drug name, dose, frequency or alert text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and the edge of a card. Decorative separation only — never the boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of every control the patient operates: text input, select, toggle, checkbox, secondary button. Holds 3.4:1 on surface-card and 3.1:1 on surface-app.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Medical Red, capped at 5-10% of any screen. Drug-interaction alerts at severity danger, a missed dose, a critical metric. Carries on-fill text at 5:1. Always paired with a glyph or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Added amber (not in the supplied palette). Dose taken_late, refill and depletion alerts, interaction severity warning, and the pending_medical_review state. Carries on-fill text at 6.4:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Added teal-green (not in the supplied palette), placed off the red-green axis so it stays separable from danger for red-green colour-vision deficiency. Dose taken_on_time and interaction auto_cleared. Carries on-fill text at 5.2:1.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any navy, navy-soft, danger, warning or success fill. All five pass 4.5:1 with it; none of them is safe with navy text on top.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Rare: the identity-verification welcome and empty-state headlines. Not for routine screens.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The screen title, once per screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: A section heading inside a screen, and the headline of the interaction alert banner.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading size across the app. Never go below 16px anywhere the patient reads in order to act — the primary audience is elderly.
styles.sample: حبة واحدة بعد الأكل، يوم بعد يوم

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Drug names, dose amounts, frequencies and alert headlines — the exact facts a patient must not misread.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary metadata: source clinic and sector, dispense date, list captions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text beneath a field, fine print.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, form field labels, dose-status pills, sector chips. Keep the letter-spacing in English; drop any uppercase transform in Arabic, which has no letter case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and the label beside it.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner gap of a status pill or chip; gap between two tightly related lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between fields in a row, and the minimum page gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards in a list; spacing between form field groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections of a screen, and the page gutter at tablet and desktop width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above the interaction alert banner and before a screen's footer actions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, prescription rows and primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets and the interaction alert banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dose-status pills, sector tags and caregiver initials.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation of a card above surface-app. Tinted navy rather than neutral grey so it belongs to the palette.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The interaction alert banner, modals and bottom sheets — the only elements that should read as floating above everything else.
